newsitem.title: UK: General Accident hit by MSCI index deletion.
newsitem.headline: General Accident hit by MSCI index deletion.

text.p: Shares in UK insurance group General Accident Plc were down 2.7 percent in late afternoon dealings on Monday, hit by the stock's deletion from Morgan Stanley's Capital International Index, traders said.

General Accident shares were down 18p at 640 at 1505 GMT in volume of 2.9 million shares while Royal Sun Alliance Plc, which will replace General Accident in the index, was up 9.5p or 2.33 percent at 417p in trade of 3.0 million.
Morgan Stanley said the move was part of a quarterly structural review of the MSCI indices but gave no further reason for the changes.
Other UK companies deleted from the index were Lucas Industries, following its merger with Varity Corp, and building group Costain Group Plc, Morgan Stanley said.
Lucas, up 0.5p at 241p, will be replaced in the index by the new Lucas Varity. Costain was down 6p at 60.
